title.narrative: REPLACEMENT AWARDS FOR FY2019 - STRENGTHENING AND FURTHER EXPAND THE COMMUNITY LED PATROLLING MODEL TO PROTECT NORTHERN WHITE-CHEEKED GIBBON POPULATIONS IN LAO

description.narrative: The status of gibbons in Lao PDR has shown increasing declines although a significant population remains in Phou Sithone Endangered Species Conservation Area (PST ESCA). Two key threats endanger gibbon populations in Lao PDR and the targeted landscape: illegal hunting/trade and habitat disturbance. Drivers of these threats and deforestation persist. This grant seeks to expand and further strengthen the operations of the community patrol model that has been supported through USFWS GACF. This project will address threats to gibbon species, build local capacity, and respond to government and community inclusion by strengthening community led patrolling in PST ESCA.
